papers.summary: Language model agents are increasingly asked to run ongoing multi-day operations rather than finish isolated single-turn tasks. papers.title: Beam Model Technical Report
papers.summary: Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 501.3B total parameters and 23.4B active parameters, specifically built and optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads. Beam delivers frontier level reasoning, while requiring 3-4x less inference compute than many models of its class. Pretrained on 23.8T diverse, curated, high-quality tokens, Beam features a 1M-token context window achieved through a novel two-stage midtraining phase, built on verifiable, correctness-anchored data.

news.title: Z.ai's GLM-5.4 aims to match models up to four times its size by running 28 layers twice
news.summary: GLM-5.4 is Z.ai's first flagship built on a Loop Transformer architecture, which reuses the same layers more than once instead of stacking new ones, so the model gets more depth and more computation per token without adding parameters. Thinking Machines Lab used a looped transformer in its Inkling 2 Mini model, which was released last week. Read more

news.title: Claude Fable 5.2 cost three times as much as Opus 5.5 for nearly the same results in a VentureBeat bug-fixing test
news.summary: Claude Fable 5.2, Anthropic's top model, passed 10 of 15 bug-fix tries in a VentureBeat pilot test at a total cost of about $89. Opus 5.5 passed 9 of 15 at a total cost of about $29.
